texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Judith Olszowy-Schlanger, Karaite Marriage Contracts from the Cairo Geniza (Boston: Brill, 1997).
texts.html:
ENA NS 3.23 Recto

  1. … Ḥusn the young girl, the virgin …
  2. … [David] the groom, our Lord and Master …
  3. … fifty sheqels a pair of wristbands …
  4. … with semi-precious stones … forty two …
  5. … candle-stick and an incense burner […] five …
  6. … one hundred one dinars. From the [clothing] …
  7. … Mastiᶜanī of silk, fifty dinars; a red undershirt …
  8. … sky-blue, thirty dinars; a red mattress, three …
  9. … dinars; a plain tunic with golden thread, twenty dinars; …
  10. … ten dinars, a plain red dress with an emblem, six
  11. … of Dabīqī linen, five dinars; a farajiyya of Dabīqī linen, six …
  12. … dinars. The total value of the clothes is two hundred and six
  13. … dinars; a pad of Dabīqī linen and two pairs of cushions
  14. … one hundred and forty dinars …
  15. … mother-of-pearl, three dinars …
  16. … upon him …
  17. … except for what is lost
  18. … And if, God forbid,
  19. … [he] will not owe
  20. … the sighting of the Moon
  21. … this bride about all which is
  22. … in the possession of Ḥusn, the young girl
